description: Provide an allowlisted controller that switches the disposable stack between the canonical healthy baseline and named broken states using one declared authority per scenario.
acceptance: Required scenarios cover category, root-folder, application-sync, path mapping, cross-device hardlink, unreachable service, unsupported version, stale plan, and destructive denial.
Every scenario declares exactly one driver: controller-api, host-compose, or runner-config.
Applying the same scenario twice is idempotent and healthy restores the verified baseline.
Host-compose operations verify the exact Compose project and lab labels before bounded lifecycle or topology changes.
Neither controller nor runner receives Docker-socket access and no scenario changes files outside the marked lab root.
Topology scenarios use committed, rendered Compose override files under lab/scenarios rather than dynamically generated or inline YAML.
